messages:
maria: Heads-up: urgent hotfix for kv-cache eviction causing 503s in embeddings. Need expedited deploy now. Canary + rollback criteria below. @release-manager @sre-lead
release-manager: Can we fast-track? What's the exact change and rollback plan?
maria: Patch: relax eviction threshold + fix race in drain path. Change set: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4512. Risk: affects only embed worker; compat tested. Need two approvers + SRE watch.
alex: I can approve if canary passes and we have automated rollback trigger on 5xx spike >2% for 3m. Also need DB conn pool hold for 10m post-deploy.
kevin: :thumbsup: I approve. tagging @tara for release note.
tara: Got it. I'll draft release note. Please paste a one-liner and user impact.
maria: One-liner: Fix kv-cache premature eviction causing embed generator 503s. User impact: short-term increased latency/503s for some embed requests; should be resolved with this patch.
deploybot: deploybot: deploy request received for infra/kv-cache@patch-4512 by maria. Starting canary in eu-west1. Command: ```/deploy infra/kv-cache patch-4512 --canary 5% --rollout 5m```
ops-bot: ops-bot: change window approved by on-call. Quiet window: now -> +30m
deploybot: deploybot: canary started (5% traffic) in eu-west1. Monitoring metrics: embed 5xx, latency p95, cpu.
sre-lead: Watching. If embed 5xx >2% sustained for 3m -> abort. Also set fallback model to smaller shard if latency spike.
deploybot: deploybot: canary telemetry: embed_5xx=0.4% (1m avg), p95 latency +8ms, cpu stable. Status: healthy.
alex: Looks good so far. Approving rollforward to 50%.
maria: Proceeding to rollout 50% now. Command used: ```/deploy infra/kv-cache patch-4512 --rollout 50% --wait 2m```
deploybot: deploybot: rollout to 50% complete; embed_5xx=0.6%, p95 +12ms.
kevin: Approving full rollout once final hold check passes.
deploybot: deploybot: final rollout to 100% initiated.
deploybot: deploybot: ALERT — embed_5xx spike detected: 2.8% over 4m in eu-west1. Triggering automated rollback.
maria: On it. Initiating manual rollback and alerting on-call.
deploybot: deploybot: rollback to infra/kv-cache@main successful. Traffic restored. Canary aborted.
sre-lead: Good catch. Need postmortem/outage note. Also, can we pin the previous stable image and reopen the PR to add more checks?
release-manager: Recording event, will draft incident note. @maria please add root cause + timeline when available.
tara: I'll update release notes to say we aborted rollout due to regression; users unaffected after rollback.
maria: Quick postmortem draft: race condition in drain path only triggered under 50% rollout; adding additional unit/integration test and gate for evictions. Filing follow-up task: #RT-8432.
kevin: :+1: Re-approving expedited re-deploy after tests and non-prod canary.
